title: 第十九章 虫感谢唐苏木的盟主第二十章 圈境感谢你萌又发现了一只墨墨的盟主
lines: 坍塌的工厂中，烟尘弥漫。
就在数十只食尸鬼的围攻里，闻雯仿佛闲庭信步一样的向前，随意的挥手，将拦路的鬼东西一下一个的挂在拔地而起的锋锐晶体之树上。
面对她的质问，电话里的声音还在继续，毫无烦躁和不快，仿佛永远的好脾气，耐心面对一切病人的质问与责难。
反正一分钟十六万联邦币的咨询费一毛钱都不会少，不够一分按一分钟算。
来电方——【希望医院·化验部】
“您昨天所送检的编号R54447，来自患者祝虹的病毒样本化验分析报告已经完成。”
名为穆勒的医师缓缓说道：“我们很遗憾的通知您，这并非是前面几次NO.109血渴症的标准样本，而是从血渴症的基础上异化迭代之后的新型菌株。”
闻雯问：“什么意思？”
“唔，用外行人能理解的话来说，就是比原版还要强的升级特化版！”
穆勒解释道：“众所周知，血渴症的原始版本来自中土，是中土的祭祀王在孽化失控之后所产生的瘟疫。
其具体的病症表现我不在此多做叙述，最终结果是将宿主彻底异化成孽化生物里β型食尸鬼。
而您所提供的菌株则完全不同。
它对宿主的异化只不过是表象，更像是一种对工具的改造，宿主所吸食的血液、生命乃至灵质，最终都将归于菌株本身。
就像是寄生虫一样，重点不在于宿主，而在于菌株。
到头来，就连宿主本身都会被菌株全部吃光，只留下菌株本身，供应控制者调取使用。
只要使用得当的话，短短几天之内汇聚海量的生命和灵质也不是什么难事。”
说到这里，穆勒就忍不住感慨道：“作为工具而言，这样的菌株实在是简便又实惠，非常具有性价比。”
自对方的语气中，闻雯敏锐的察觉到了一丝不协，下意识的咬牙：“你们为什么会这么清楚？该不会你们这帮狗东西也有联系吧？”
“当然，这可是鄙院的专利！
在四十一年前，由传染科颜主任所培育出的经典变种！”
穆勒骄傲的回答：“尽管受限于T5协议，无法大规模公开运用，但购买过相应技术的合作方，没有一个不对我院的技术水平交口称赞的！”
“你特么——”
闻雯差点把手机捏碎了，尽管心里清楚，对于【希望医院】的这帮研究疯子来说，道德和伦理还不如一片纸尿裤来得有用好使，但依旧忍不住想要打人。
你说当初老娘怎么就没选那个能够隔着电脑给人一大逼斗的矩阵呢？
否则还能受这鸟气？！
“不过还请放心，我院至今尚不具备外出巡诊的资质和许可，自然不会对院区之外的主权领土有所干涉。
根据和联邦安全局的合作协议，遇到这种恐怖袭击，我们是一定会全力配合的。”
穆勒赶快说道：“按照本院的规定，所有评价为C1级以及以上的成果和产品，都严禁向非合作方传播，所有接触者也都会在访客接待中心的档案库中留有痕迹。
根据记录，目前持有且懂得运用该菌株的人，总有四十一個。
而在其中，唯一一个和龙祭会有所瓜葛的，是十六年前，因为学术不端被我院所开除的前急诊科助理医师‘安德烈亚斯·劳伦斯’。”
“或者，您更熟悉他的另一个称呼……”
穆勒吐出了那个名字：“【虫】。”
荣登联邦和帝国双榜的悬赏通缉犯，北方群山监狱的越狱者，昔日一手缔造了帝国花月惨案的邪教徒。
龙祭会十六位牧者之一，畸变之虫。
“倘若是他的话，您可要小心了。”
穆勒最后提醒，“那家伙，做事的时候，总喜欢闹点大乱子出来……”
闻雯没有说话。
content_en:
The collapsed factory was filled with smoke and dust.
Under the siege of dozens of ghouls, Wen Wen moved forward as if strolling in a leisurely manner, waving her hands casually and hanging the ghosts blocking her path one by one on the sharp crystal tree rising from the ground.
In the face of her questioning, the voice on the phone continued without any irritation or displeasure, as if he was always good-tempered and patiently faced all the patients' questions and accusations.
Anyway, the consultation fee of 160,000 federal dollars per minute is not less than a dime. If it is less than one point, it will be calculated as one minute.
Caller——[Hope Hospital·Laboratory Department]
"The laboratory analysis report of the virus sample from patient Zhu Hong, number R54447, that you sent for testing yesterday has been completed."
The doctor named Muller slowly said: "We regret to inform you that this is not the standard sample of the previous NO. 109 blood thirst syndrome, but a new strain that is modified and iterated on the basis of blood thirst syndrome."
Wen Wen asked: "What do you mean?"
"Well, to put it in layman's terms, it's an upgraded and specialized version that's even better than the original version!"
Muller explained: “As we all know, the original version of blood thirst came from Middle-earth, and it was a plague caused by the sacrificial kings of Middle-earth after their sins got out of control.
I will not describe the specific manifestations of the disease here. The final result is that the host is completely transformed into a β-type ghoul among evil creatures.
And the strains you offer are completely different.
Its alienation to the host is only superficial, more like a modification of the tool. The blood, life and even spiritual essence sucked by the host will eventually belong to the strain itself.
Just like with parasites, the focus is not on the host, but on the strain.
In the end, even the host itself will be eaten up by the strain, leaving only the strain itself for the controller to use.
As long as it is used properly, it is not difficult to gather a massive amount of life and spiritual essence in just a few days. "
Speaking of this, Muller couldn't help but sigh: "As a tool, this strain is really simple and affordable, and very cost-effective."
"Wait-"
From the other party's tone, Wen Wen was keenly aware of a hint of discord, and subconsciously gritted her teeth: "Why do you know so well? Could it be that you guys are also in contact?"
"Of course, this is the patent of this court!
A classic variant developed by Director Yan of the Department of Infectious Diseases 41 years ago! "
Muller replied proudly: "Although it is restricted by the T5 agreement and cannot be used publicly on a large scale, none of the partners who have purchased the corresponding technology have not praised the technical level of our institute!"
"What the hell -"
Wen Wen almost crushed her phone to pieces. Although she knew in her heart that for the research lunatics at [Hope Hospital], morals and ethics were not as useful as a diaper, she still couldn't help but want to hit someone.
Why didn't I choose the matrix that could give people a hard fight through the computer?
Otherwise, would you still be able to bear this bird's anger? !
"However, please rest assured that our hospital does not yet have the qualifications and permission to conduct medical rounds outside the hospital, so it will naturally not interfere with the sovereign territory outside the hospital area.
According to the cooperation agreement with the Federal Security Service, we will definitely cooperate fully when encountering such a terrorist attack. "
Muller quickly said: "According to the regulations of this hospital, all achievements and products rated C1 and above are strictly prohibited from being disseminated to non-partners, and all contacts will also leave traces in the archives of the visitor reception center.
According to records, there are currently forty-one people who possess and know how to use this strain.
Among them, the only one who has anything to do with the Dragon Festival is Andreas Lawrence, a former assistant physician in the emergency department who was expelled from our hospital for academic misconduct sixteen years ago. "
"Or, you are more familiar with another name for him..."
Mueller spat out the name: "[Insect]."
A wanted criminal on both the federal and imperial lists, an escapee from the Northern Mountain Prison, and the cultist who single-handedly created the Empire's Flower Moon Massacre in the past.
One of the sixteen pastors of the Dragon Festival, a deformed insect.
"If it's him, you have to be careful."
Mueller finally reminded, "That guy always likes to make big troubles when he does things..."
Wen Wen said nothing.
